notes.title: Steam Trading Cards Now Available!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/oSZ1zBf.jpg[/img]

Crab Cakes Rescue now has Steam Trading Cards! Thanks for your continued support. We hope you enjoy the cards.

[h1]Set Features:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]6 cards
    [*]6 badges
    [*]3 backgrounds
    [*]5 emoticons
[/list]
